project: IRL Activity Network (working title; name not final)

source_reference.interpretation: Three overlapping mobile mockups on a soft cool-grey canvas. Use the same composition, hierarchy, rounded geometry, pale periwinkle surfaces, white cards, black pill CTAs and playful editorial illustration style as a design reference. Adapt all content and make original assets; do not copy another product's logo, mascot, copy or proprietary icons.

canvas.presentation: three device mockups with soft shadows; front-facing, no perspective warp

visual_language.shape_language: large rounded cards, pill filters, compact circular icon buttons, soft inner contrast, strong black primary CTA
visual_language.typography: rounded geometric sans for headings; neutral highly legible sans for body; bold short labels
visual_language.illustration: one original expressive activity mascot, flat/vector or 2.5D, with small orbiting activity pictograms
visual_language.density: moderate; each screen has one dominant visual, one primary action and a few secondary choices

left_device.headline: Your Social Roadmap & Daily Quests
sections: original mascot in an energetic pose
two dark rounded quest rows with leading circular icon and trailing chevron/progress
left_device.adaptation_notes: Replace course lessons with real-world social milestones; progress must count verified completed activities, not swipes or messages. Include rest-day and streak-freeze options.

sections: large blue featured live-plan card with title, host, time, people count and Join CTA
two pastel activity cards with progress or capacity indicator
center_device.adaptation_notes: The featured card is an activity, not a paid person/companion. Keep activity cards readable at small sizes. Show coarse distance, not exact live user location.

right_device.title: Plan Assistant
sections: large blue assistant card with animated original orb/mascot
camera/mic/text quick input modes where applicable
usage indicator only if AI limits exist
suggestion chips such as Quick break / Tonight / Try something new
right_device.adaptation_notes: AI is optional and should help shape a plan, not impersonate users or make safety decisions. A non-AI manual creation path must always remain available.

implementation_rules: Build responsive screen layouts rather than hard-coded screenshot coordinates.
Use the reference as a visual system, not a pixel-for-pixel clone of a third-party product.
Create original mascot, pictograms, illustrations, icons, sound and copy.
Keep touch targets at least 44x44 points on iOS and comfortably large on Android.
Respect safe areas, dynamic text, screen readers and Reduce Motion.
Use a consistent 8-point spacing grid and shared card, chip, button and progress components.
